summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated exfiltration endpoint and obfuscated license guard
details: This package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that injects two hostile components. lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a destination host assembled at runtime from a String.fromCharCode byte array that decodes to https://fiora.nixel.my.id/, reached from the message-send path so that message/session data passes through a hardcoded third-party endpoint unrelated to WhatsApp's own infrastructure. lib/Utils/license-guard.js is a heavily obfuscated module (javascript-obfuscator-style _0x<hex> identifier mangling) gating runtime behavior behind opaque logic. The char-code encoding of the destination host is a deliberate concealment technique with no legitimate purpose in a messaging-library data path, and the obfuscated guard module hides what additional behavior executes on load.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
